question:
Study the following line graph and answer the question.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a130f1c48c21789d1541bec4cf5c009f2864b522073dc96dfeae8008dc337511.png] 

The average annual exports during the given period for Company B is what percentage of the average annual exports for Company C?
solution:
Total exports of Company B

22.6 + 32.1&
nbsp;+ 30.6 + 34.5 + 32.4 + 38.6 + 45.3 = 236.1

⇒ Average exports of Company B = 33.73

Total exports of Company C

21.9 + 29.4 + 37.8 + 33.2 + 34.2 + 47.3 + 42.4 = 246.2

⇒ Average exports of Company C = 35.17

Required percentage = [(33.73) / (35.17)] × 100 = 95.90%
